text: Assumption: Concurrent calls shall be synchronized by the application — is this correct?

norm: concurrent calls shall be synchronized by the application
assumption: Concurrent calls shall be synchronized by the application.
rationale: The specification marks the method as "not thread-safe", but describes no internal synchronization mechanisms.
